name: GreenhouseCropCycleManager
tagline: Compartments, crop cycles, weekly crop registration and a set-truss harvest forecast – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete protected-cropping app for glasshouse vegetable and soft-fruit growers: plan crop cycles per compartment, register the crop every week (stem density, head growth, trusses, fruit weight, harvest, climate), approve registrations with a four-eyes rule, check the climate against crop bands and forecast the harvest of the coming weeks from the set-truss rate – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Weekly registration per compartment and ISO week
Draft → Submitted → Approved with Returned, Void and Restore
Cycle stages Planned → Propagation → Vegetative → Harvesting → Clearing → Ended
Set-truss harvest forecast with ripening weeks per crop
Stem density and 24 h temperature bands per crop, CO₂ and humidity limits
Cycle timeline with turnaround days between crops
Harvest in kg and kg/m², by crop and compartment
Search, 13 quick filters, filters drawer, sort, group, bulk actions, CSV export
Demo mode, undo, read-only, custom labels and colours
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: GreenhouseCropCycleManager data-set + GreenhouseCropCycleManagerPortal field)
